newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen range-bound, heavy above 126.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen range-bound, heavy above 126.00.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: INJECTION OF 200 BLN YEN
*Key September 10-year JGB futures expected to be range-bound on Tuesday, with gains capped by yen weakness against dollar and recent firmness of Tokyo share prices.
*Hedge selling related to four-year note auction expected during day may also limit upside. Some investor demand for four-year issue likely, even with coupon of 1.3 percent.
